name: Custom Shape Double-Sided Printed Acrylic LED Light With Wooden Base
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality 5mm acrylic for a sturdy, durable, and long-lasting display.
    - Features a premium pine wood base for a natural look and stable support.
    - Smooth acrylic surface helps showcase photos, names, and artwork clearly.
    - Polished edges provide a neat and refined finish.
    - USB-powered LED base is designed for convenient everyday use.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Acrylic sign size: 5.9 x 5.9 in ~ 15 x 15 cm.
    - Pine wood LED base size: 5.9 in x 1.69 in x 1.18 in ~ 15 x 4.3 x 3 cm.
    - Slot opening on the base: 0.2 in ~ 0.5 cm.
    - Slot depth: approx. 0.39 – 0.45 in ~ 1 – 1.15 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Double-sided printing on the acrylic panel.
    - Optional printing or no printing on the wooden base.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized decorative light and a meaningful keepsake.
    - Creates a warm and eye-catching display for bedrooms, living rooms, offices, or bedside tables.
    - USB-powered design makes it easy to connect to a laptop, adapter, power bank, or other USB sources.
    - The multicolor version supports 7 LED colors: red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, purple, and white.
    - The multicolor light can be adjusted to show one fixed color or a color-changing gradient.
    - The multicolor version also allows brightness adjustment and fast/slow light mode changes.
    - The light can memorize the last brightness level and light color used.
    - The monochrome version includes a simple switch for easy on/off control.
    - Freestanding design makes it easy to place on desks, shelves, counters, and display tables.
    - Suitable for displaying custom photos, family memories, couple designs, pet memorials, and personalized artwork.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for Christmas, birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays.
    - A meaningful keepsake for family members, couples, friends, and pet lovers.
    - Great as a memorial gift to honor loved ones or beloved pets.
    - Ideal for housewarming gifts, bedroom décor gifts, or desk décor gifts.
    - Perfect for giving on Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Valentine’s Day, and weddings.
    - A unique personalized gift that combines decoration, lighting, and sentimental value.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Double-Sided Printed Acrylic LED Light With Wooden Base

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
